metric: relay instructions (user and kernel, all threads) per delivered frame over a 5 s counter window after 7 s warmup

markers.learn_end: inclusive share of fixed-period instruction samples whose stack matches resume::Reader>::learn_end
markers.poll_forward_drop: inclusive share of fixed-period instruction samples whose stack matches poll_forward_drop
markers.cursor_probe: inclusive share of fixed-period instruction samples whose stack matches model::track::Cursor>::probe
markers.syscall_leaf: inclusive share of fixed-period instruction samples whose stack matches ;syscall$
markers.mutex_leaf: inclusive share of fixed-period instruction samples whose stack matches ;(lock|unlock)$
